title: Provably Efficient Risk-Sensitive Offline Reinforcement Learning via Optimized Certainty Equivalents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) addresses decision-making under uncertainty and adverse outcomes. Learning risk-sensitive policies from fixed datasets is important when additional interaction with the environment is costly. Existing work on risk-sensitive RL focuses on online settings or specific risk measures, leaving a general theoretical understanding of its offline setting underdeveloped. In this work, we investigate efficient offline risk-sensitive RL using the optimized certainty equivalent (OCE), a general class of risk measures. We consider two formulations: dynamic-OCE RL, which applies OCE recursively at each step, and static-OCE RL, which applies a single OCE to the cumulative rewards. Under the tabular setting, we develop pessimistic value-iteration algorithms for both formulations and establish tight sublinear suboptimality bounds, explicitly capturing how risk sensitivity, encoded by utility functions, affects

translated_title: 通过优化确定性等价实现可证明高效的风险敏感离线强化学习
translated_abstract: 风险敏感强化学习（RL）旨在处理不确定性下的决策问题以及不利结果带来的影响。当与环境进行额外交互的代价高昂时，从固定数据集中学习风险敏感策略就显得尤为重要。现有的风险敏感强化学习研究主要集中在线上场景或特定的风险度量上，导致对其离线场景的一般性理论理解仍不完善。在这项工作中，我们利用优化确定性等价（OCE）——一类通用的风险度量——来研究高效的离线风险敏感强化学习。我们考虑了两种形式化方式：动态OCE强化学习，它在每一步递归地应用OCE；以及静态OCE强化学习，它对累积奖励仅应用一次OCE。在表格型设置下，我们为这两种形式化方法都开发了悲观价值迭代算法，并建立了紧密的次线性次优性界限，明确刻画了由效用函数所编码的风险敏感性如何影响……
tldr: 该论文针对通用风险度量类“优化确定性等价（OCE）”下的离线风险敏感强化学习提出了动态与静态两种形式化的悲观价值迭代算法，并建立了紧密的次线性次优性理论界限，首次对该离线场景给出了一般性的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pessimistic value-iteration algorithms for both dynamic and static formulations of offline risk-sensitive RL under the general class of optimized certainty equivalent (OCE) risk measures, establishing tight sublinear suboptimality bounds and providing the first general theoretical guarantees for this offline setting.
